cohort: The study included 530 post-menopausal women with a mean age of 58.14 years from Aligarh, India.
finding: The observed prevalence of urinary incontinence was 41.3%, and it was significantly associated with increasing parity, vaginal mode of delivery, increasing BMI, central obesity, smoking, and standard of living.
mod_finding: Vaginal mode of delivery was significantly associated with urinary incontinence.
